A '''rebuilt version of the ''[[Malevolence/Legends|Malevolence]]''''' was constructed around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], at [[Pammant Docks/Legends|Pammant Docks]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] supervised the reconstruction of his [[Malevolence/Legends|flagship]], which had been destroyed during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] earlier in the war. However, this vessel was also [[Mission to Pammant|destroyed]] by a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]].
